notes: Two routes: the second begins «وعن أبي سخل» with no head written, so its head is not filled in (rule 10, no guessed link)
The Imam Abu Abdillah is written inside the chain after «عن», so he stays narrator (owner ruling 2)
Both routes carry the same report («بينا انا جالس عند رسول الله»), so the second is a group, not a separate report (rule 4); Salman is its last link
